items.label: Top-Quality Materials
items.value: Made from luxurious top-layer cowhide leather and finished with high-quality silver hardware, this shoulder bag is built to last. The dark brown interior polyester lining and bottom metal rivets offer added protection against wear and tear, making it a durable investment.

items.label: Organized Structure
items.value: This leather tote bag features 2 internal main compartments, 1 practical divider zip pocket, 1 small zipper pocket, and 2 small open pockets ideal for storing everyday items. The top zipper guarantees secure storage of your belongings.

items.label: Different Size
items.value: The small hobo purse measures (L)12.6 x (H)9.4x (W)5.5in,and the weight is 2.2pounds; the large size is (L)14.2 x (H)10.6x (W)6.1in, weight 2.4LB. Please check the size before purchasing.

items.label: Stylish and Practical
items.value: The fashion-forward design and spacious interior of this satchel bag make it the ideal accessory for carrying around your daily essentials. Its metal feet ensure the purse's shape is maintained, it's a practical and fashionable choice for women of all ages.

items.label: Multi-Wear Functionality
items.value: With dual top handles and an adjustable, detachable strap (45.27-51.57in), it can be worn as a top-handle handbag, shoulder bag, or crossbody bag. Perfect for any occasion, casual/outings/parties/work/business/dating.

items.label: Pocket Description
items.value: Slip Pocket, Zipper Pocket, back pocket

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Dry clean only. Gentle hand wash for interior.
